module_role: Partial M-621 ATCT schedule inventory. It anchors every visible equipment row across AHU, FCU, CRAH, fan, humidifier, cabinet-unit-heater, pump and boiler schedules and preserves concise literal schedule specifications. Full plan/controller reconciliation remains open.
